regions.name: seoultone-doctor-bio
regions.mechanism: seoultone sets html{scroll-behavior:smooth}. runScrollPass issues window.scrollBy(0, step) and reads window.scrollY in the SAME evaluate, so the animated scroll reports moved===0 and `if (m.moved <= 0) break;` ends the pass after one step (scrollSteps 1, scrollDistancePx 0 at BOTH viewports). ScrollReveal (<html class="sr">) therefore never fires below ~1,600px, the collector records opacity:0 + translateY(-25px) on the reveal wrappers, and the SiteSpec and clone bake that in faithfully.

contentLocationInClone.summary: Present at correct geometry, opacity 0, translateY(-25px), no clip, not offscreen. 69 zero-opacity nodes in the clone (matches QA clone.zeroOpacityNodes 69) against 18/19 in the source.

desktopSubtree.what: 20 credential <li> items, each individually revealed by ScrollReveal

regions.recoveryNotes: Measured on the LIVE source. Observer policy today: 36 zero-opacity elements / 3,642 zero-opacity chars. With behavior:'instant' at 0.85vh/250ms: 19 / 1,131 and all five div.text wrappers reveal. With behavior:'instant' at 0.5vh/700ms: 5 / 69, and the 5 survivors are two empty span.swiper-notification aria live regions and one inactive swiper-slide, which SHOULD stay hidden. ScrollReveal is reset:false, so a scroll-to-bottom-and-return leaves everything revealed at the moment the collector runs.

proposedFix.function: runScrollPass (line 313; scroll issue at 326-336, progress break at 370)
proposedFix.change: (1) Issue the scroll as window.scrollTo({top: window.scrollY + step, behavior: 'instant'}) so an author's scroll-behavior:smooth cannot fake moved===0. (2) Compute `moved` from a SECOND page.evaluate taken AFTER the existing SCROLL_STEP_SETTLE_MS wait, and only then apply `if (moved <= 0) break;` — the QA capture already behaves this way (src/responsive-qa/capture.ts:271-289 never breaks on non-progress) and reaches the bottom of this exact page in 11 steps. (3) DWELL: SCROLL_STEP_FRACTION 0.85 / SCROLL_STEP_SETTLE_MS 250 (src/observer/types.ts:264,268) leaves staggered per-item reveals unfinished; lower the fraction and raise the dwell, or add a bounded second slow pass (SCROLL_MAX_TOTAL_MS 15000 already caps cost). (4) OBSERVABILITY: the reveal probe (layout-probe.ts:100-144) seeds candidates only from class/style MutationObserver records, so it can only report revealed-then-re-hidden and can never see never-revealed. Add a never-revealed census beside regressedAfterReturn; the raw material already exists as paintSuppression.suppressedBelowFold 78 with scrollRevealMarked 0.

crossCuttingFindings.statement: float and clear are in NEITHER the Observer STYLE_WHITELIST (src/observer/types.ts:430-582) NOR the QA property list (src/reconstruction-qa/capture-page.ts:150-330). Every float-based carousel or legacy float grid in the corpus fails the same way and no channel can name it.

text-indent is in the QA-only tail but not in the Observer whitelist. slick arrows use text-indent:-9999px; overflow:hidden, so the clone paints literal 'Previous'/'Next' inside the 60px circles — the artefact in the 28.7 review pack. It also explains contentMinLeft -9999 on both sides of the severance census.

Nothing in the 40-channel responsive-QA roster measures paint occlusion or z-order. image-presence-ratio counts image leaves with a box, so a fully buried image counts as present; missing-text-ratio counts text at token boundaries, so white-on-white counts as painted. This is why the instrument reported image-presence-ratio 1 / missing-text-ratio 0 / visible-text-ratio 1 on a page with a blank hero.

The Observer's preparation scroll (src/observer/layout-probe.ts:313 runScrollPass) breaks on a synchronously-read moved<=0; the QA capture scroll (src/responsive-qa/capture.ts:271-289) does not break at all. On seoultone that difference is 0px vs 3992px of travel, i.e. the QA measures a well-scrolled source against a clone baked from a never-scrolled observation.

regressedAfterReturn can only ever count revealed-then-re-hidden elements, because the reveal probe seeds candidates from a class/style MutationObserver. Never-revealed elements are structurally invisible to it. paintSuppression.suppressedBelowFold (78) with scrollRevealMarked (0) already carries the signal and nothing consumes it.

mustNotBuild: No React/Vue/jQuery/slick/ScrollReveal runtime emulator — all four regions are cured by two CSS properties, one re-homed declaration and one scroll-loop fix; none needs the source's JavaScript re-executed.
No universal responsive solver — every geometry in all four regions is already exact at the observed widths.
No per-site special cases — no .slick-slide rule, no html.sr detection, no site-name branch.

No 'reveal-everything' hack — do not force opacity:1 on captured elements and do not strip opacity:0 in the compiler; that fabricates a state the source never had and would un-hide genuinely hidden carousel slides.
unknowns: Which of the 7 popup strings the QA's 390 source capture actually painted — the popup did not fire on any fresh load on 2026-09-05, so the split is a bounded range (21-41 chars) with the artifact's 37-char width-delta as the point estimate. Why it fires for some loads and not others was not determined.

Whether float's absence causes further defects elsewhere in the corpus. Three tracks on one severance page are proven; the corpus was not swept. A float-based multi-column grid or nav would fail identically and nothing in the artifacts would say so.
How much of severance's remaining 33.45% pixel residual the two fixes remove — that needs a responsive-QA rerun after the code change, out of this read-only lane's scope.

Whether the 28.7 A4 reveal-regression policy (src/observer/dedupe-styles.ts:210-256) behaves well once the scroll is fixed and far more elements become reveal candidates; that path has not been exercised at that volume.
The dwell time that finishes ScrollReveal-style staggers generically. 0.5vh/700ms works on seoultone; the right value is a corpus question.
Why the clone's severance header wraps to two rows and overlaps the hero once the hero is restored — a pre-existing defect the white band was hiding, not investigated.
verdictLines: REGION severance-hero — CATEGORY C — OWNER reconstruction — the observed <body>'s background is emitted as an in-flow block background instead of being propagated to the document canvas, so it paints over the z-index:-1 hero image and the hero's white text is left white-on-white.

REGION severance-news — CATEGORY C — OWNER observer — float is absent from the Observer's computed-style whitelist, so slick's float:left slides stack vertically at the track origin, land at x = -543 under the track's translateX(-981px), and are clipped away by .slick-list{overflow:hidden}.

REGION severance-promo-carousel — CATEGORY C — OWNER observer — the same missing float:left on a second slick track (translateX(-777px)) stacks its cards at x = -560 where the track's clipping ancestor removes them; the background and dot pager survive because they sit outside the track.

REGION seoultone-doctor-bio — CATEGORY A — OWNER observer — html{scroll-behavior:smooth} makes window.scrollBy asynchronous, runScrollPass reads window.scrollY synchronously and breaks on moved<=0 after one step (0px travelled), so ScrollReveal never fires below the fold and the collector records opacity:0 for the bio block and four headings.
